name: reliant
description: AI-powered coding assistant with intelligent agents for professional software development
author: Reliant Labs <support@reliantlabs.io>

scripts.dev:fresh: rm -f ../.ports.json ../.instance-info && node scripts/kill-ports.js && npm run dev
scripts.build:backend: cd .. && go build -buildvcs=false -o dist/reliant.tmp ./cmd/reliant/ && mv dist/reliant.tmp dist/reliant
scripts.test: node --test test/auth-storage.test.js test/backend-auth.test.js test/daemon-creds.test.js test/backend-manager-readiness.test.js test/backend-manager-awaiting-credentials.test.js test/backend-manager-orphan-cleanup.test.js test/backend-manager-daemon-connected.test.js test/backend-manager-daemon-restart-event.test.js test/backend-manager-orphan-sweep-once.test.js test/backend-manager-daemon-stream-notice.test.js test/menu-accelerators.test.js test/navigation-policy.test.js test/child-signals.test.js test/app-protocol.test.js test/scheme-privileges.test.js test/oauth-loopback.test.js test/oauth-provider-login.test.js test/oauth-contract.test.js test/renderer-health.test.js test/diagnostics.test.js test/release-config-targets.test.js
scripts.pack: npm run build:config && npm run build:web && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.js
scripts.pack:alpha: npm run build:config && npm run build:web:alpha && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.alpha.js
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build:config && npm run build:web && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.js
scripts.pack:mac:dev: npm run build:config && npm run build:web:alpha && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.dev.js
scripts.pack:mac:alpha: npm run build:config && npm run build:web:alpha && ../scripts/build-electron.sh mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.alpha.js
scripts.pack:pr: npm run build:config && npm run build:web:alpha && electron-builder --config electron-builder.pr.js --dir --publish=never
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:config && npm run build:web && ../scripts/build-electron.sh win && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.js
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build:config && npm run build:web && ../scripts/build-electron.sh linux && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.js
